title: NuclearScience Iodine131DecayAnalysis

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed flame speed vs chamber pressure analysis. Analyzed 68 paired measurements from bench combustion experiments. Compared 4 regression models (linear, polynomial, exponential, power law). The 2nd-degree polynomial model provided the best fit (R² = 0.7646). Generated 4 figures and comprehensive research report in report/report.md.
